ui.chat.voice.toggle_on.role: icon button label and tooltip in the conversation header
ui.chat.voice.toggle_on.note: Turns hands-free voice on for this one conversation.

ui.chat.voice.toggle_off.role: icon button label and tooltip in the conversation header
ui.chat.voice.toggle_off.note: Shown while this conversation holds voice.

ui.chat.voice.toggle_switch.role: icon button label and tooltip in the conversation header
ui.chat.voice.toggle_switch.note: {title} is the title of the conversation that holds voice now and will lose it; it is quoted.

ui.chat.voice.marker.role: screen-reader text after a sidebar row's title
ui.chat.voice.marker.note: Announced for the one row whose conversation holds voice.

ui.chat.voice.phase_starting.role: status word beside the voice button
ui.chat.voice.phase_starting.note: The local speech models are loading (about 15-20 s).

ui.chat.voice.phase_listening.role: status word beside the voice button
ui.chat.voice.phase_listening.note: Voice is on, the models are loaded and a voice page is connected, so the microphone is live.

ui.chat.voice.phase_hearing.role: status word beside the voice control
ui.chat.voice.phase_hearing.note: The local speech recogniser says someone is speaking right now.

ui.chat.voice.phase_speaking.role: status word beside the voice control
ui.chat.voice.phase_speaking.note: The voice is playing a reply right now; it returns to Listening when the reply ends.

ui.chat.voice.phase_working.role: status word beside the voice button
ui.chat.voice.phase_working.note: Spoken words were sent and the conversation is answering.

ui.chat.voice.phase_error.role: status word beside the voice button
ui.chat.voice.phase_error.note: The voice rig or the last step failed; the tooltip carries the reason.

ui.chat.voice.start_rig.role: small button beside the voice button
ui.chat.voice.start_rig.note: Shown after an app restart while voice is still on: starts the speech models.

ui.chat.voice.switched_from.note: {title} is the conversation that lost voice to this one.

ui.chat.voice.enable_failed.note: {reason} is a server sentence, shown verbatim.

ui.chat.voice.disable_failed.note: {reason} is a server sentence, shown verbatim.

ui.chat.voice.utterance_failed.note: Spoken words did not reach the conversation. {reason} is a server or app sentence.

ui.chat.voice.not_enabled.note: Voice moved to another conversation or was turned off while words were in flight.

ui.chat.voice.empty_transcript.note: The speech recognizer heard no words.

ui.chat.voice.approval_waiting.note: An approval card appeared; voice announces it but only the on-screen card can answer it.

ui.chat.voice.card_pending.note: Words spoken while a card is pending are refused; the card must be answered on screen.

ui.chat.voice.stream_lost.note: The app stopped receiving this conversation's updates, so replies cannot be spoken.

ui.chat.voice.toggle_switch_untitled.role: icon button label and tooltip in the conversation header
ui.chat.voice.toggle_switch_untitled.note: The conversation that holds voice now has no title.

ui.chat.voice.switched_from_untitled.note: Voice moved to this conversation from one that has no title.

ui.chat.voice.phase_unheard.role: status word beside the voice control
ui.chat.voice.phase_unheard.note: The speech models are loaded, but the hidden voice page is not connected, so nothing can hear yet. Followed by a Retry action.

ui.chat.voice.try_again.role: small text button beside the error

ui.chat.voice.error_start_failed.note: The local speech models failed to start; the detail is in the tooltip.

ui.chat.voice.error_exited.note: The local speech models stopped while voice was on.

ui.chat.voice.error_not_sent.note: The last thing the user said could not be delivered to the conversation.

ui.chat.voice.card_pending_short.role: status hint beside the voice button
ui.chat.voice.card_pending_short.note: An approval or question is on screen; spoken words are refused until it is answered there.

ui.chat.voice.open_session.note: Opens the conversation that holds voice, where an approval or question waits.

ui.chat.voice.mic_blocked.role: status word beside the voice control
ui.chat.voice.mic_blocked.note: macOS has denied the app the microphone, so the voice page cannot hear. Followed by an Open Settings action.

ui.chat.voice.open_settings.role: small text button beside the status word
ui.chat.voice.open_settings.note: Opens the macOS Microphone privacy pane where the app can be allowed.

ui.chat.voice.retry.role: small text button beside the status word
ui.chat.voice.retry.note: Recreates the hidden voice page and reconnects it to the local speech models.

ui.chat.voice.phase_mic_prompting.role: status word beside the voice control
ui.chat.voice.phase_mic_prompting.note: The OS microphone prompt is up and has not been answered yet. Followed by an Open Settings action.

ui.chat.voice.take_too_long.role: one-line notice in the voice strip
ui.chat.voice.take_too_long.tone: plain statement plus one short instruction
ui.chat.voice.take_too_long.note: A take was discarded because it ran past the speech VAD cap. Rare; the person should keep takes shorter.

ui.chat.voice.phase_interrupted.role: status chip in the composer strip
ui.chat.voice.phase_interrupted.note: The reply being played was cut off — by speech, by a new take, or by turning voice off.

ui.chat.voice.phase_off.role: status chip in the composer strip
ui.chat.voice.phase_off.note: Voice holds this conversation but the speech rig is stopped (the app was relaunched). Followed by a “Start voice” action.

ui.chat.voice.starting_caption.role: caption beside the strip’s status chip
ui.chat.voice.starting_caption.note: The local speech models are loading; about 15-20 seconds the first time.

ui.chat.voice.idle_caption.role: caption beside the strip’s status chip
ui.chat.voice.idle_caption.note: The microphone is live: the person can speak, or type in the box below.

ui.chat.voice.heard_label.role: lead-in before the words a take was heard as
ui.chat.voice.heard_label.note: Followed by the take’s transcript, quoted by the surrounding markup.

ui.chat.voice.said_label.role: lead-in before the words a reply was spoken as
ui.chat.voice.said_label.note: Followed by the spoken text; the server may have cut it at the character cap.

ui.chat.voice.reply_ended.role: status chip in the composer strip, shown for 1.5 s
ui.chat.voice.reply_ended.note: The reply finished playing; the strip returns to “Listening” by itself. Never shown when a reply was cancelled.

ui.chat.voice.interrupted_caption.note: {time} is m:ss into the reply, e.g. 0:24, so a real barge-in is distinguishable from a phantom cut.

ui.chat.voice.interrupted_at.role: event row in the voice history panel
ui.chat.voice.interrupted_at.note: {time} is m:ss into the reply, e.g. 0:24. The row stays in the history after the strip’s chip has gone.

ui.chat.voice.not_sent_approve.role: caption beside the strip’s approval chip, and an event row in the history
ui.chat.voice.not_sent_approve.note: Words spoken while an approval or question card is on screen are refused; the card must be answered there. May be followed by the refused transcript.

ui.chat.voice.approve_on_screen.role: chip that is itself a button, in the composer strip
ui.chat.voice.approve_on_screen.note: Pressing it scrolls the conversation to the card that is waiting for an answer.

ui.chat.voice.mic_blocked_caption.role: caption beside the strip’s “Microphone blocked” chip
ui.chat.voice.mic_blocked_caption.note: macOS denied microphone access to this app; the Open Settings action is beside it.

ui.chat.voice.cut_chip.role: chip-shaped button in the composer strip
ui.chat.voice.cut_chip.note: The reply that was just spoken was cut at the character cap; the rest is in the message above. Pressing it scrolls there. Stays until the next take.

ui.chat.voice.cut_note.role: note under the spoken half of a voice history row
ui.chat.voice.cut_note.note: The number is deliberately absent: the cap is a server setting the renderer does not read on this surface.

ui.chat.voice.history_hide.role: text on the history toggle while the panel is open
ui.chat.voice.history_hide.note: Collapses the voice history panel above the strip.

ui.chat.voice.history_last.role: count beside the voice history panel’s heading
ui.chat.voice.history_last.note: {count} is how many rows the panel holds, at most five.

ui.chat.voice.empty_history.role: empty state inside the voice history panel
ui.chat.voice.empty_history.note: Nothing has been said through voice in this window yet. The example in quotes is a real thing to try.

ui.chat.voice.you_label.role: row label in the voice history panel
ui.chat.voice.you_label.note: The person’s own speech, transcribed by the local recogniser.

ui.chat.voice.voice_label.role: row label in the voice history panel
ui.chat.voice.voice_label.note: What the assistant said back through the speakers.

ui.chat.voice.working_row.role: placeholder under the Voice label while a take is being answered
ui.chat.voice.working_row.note: The answer is not known yet; it is replaced by the spoken text when it arrives.

ui.chat.voice.notice_elsewhere_prefix.role: the “voice is on elsewhere” notice in the composer, before the conversation title
ui.chat.voice.notice_elsewhere_prefix.note: The title follows in bold, then two actions: move the slot here, or go there.

ui.chat.voice.notice_elsewhere_untitled.role: the “voice is on elsewhere” notice when that conversation has no title
ui.chat.voice.notice_elsewhere_untitled.note: Used in place of the prefix plus a title.

ui.chat.voice.move_here.role: text action in the “voice is on elsewhere” notice
ui.chat.voice.move_here.note: Moves the voice slot to the conversation on screen; the other conversation loses it.

ui.chat.voice.go_there.role: text action in the “voice is on elsewhere” notice
ui.chat.voice.go_there.note: Opens the conversation that holds voice now.

ui.chat.voice.another_conversation.note: Stands in for a conversation title when the holder has none.

ui.chat.voice.dictation_off_voice.role: tooltip on the dictation microphone while voice holds this conversation
ui.chat.voice.dictation_off_voice.note: Voice and dictation cannot both hold the microphone. The escape named is turning voice off.

ui.chat.voice.dictation_off_voice_elsewh.role: tooltip on the dictation microphone while voice holds another conversation
ui.chat.voice.dictation_off_voice_elsewh.note: {title} is the conversation that holds voice; it is quoted. Moving the slot here keeps dictation off, turning voice off restores it.

ui.chat.voice.history.role: text on the voice strip's history toggle, and the heading of the panel it opens
ui.chat.voice.history.note: Opens this window's list of spoken exchanges; the same word labels it once open.

ui.chat.voice.phase_paused.role: status chip in the composer strip
ui.chat.voice.phase_paused.note: Voice is paused: the hidden page is closed so nothing is heard or spoken, and the speech models stay loaded. The action beside it is Resume.

ui.chat.voice.strip_pause.role: icon button in the composer strip, and its tooltip
ui.chat.voice.strip_pause.note: Stops the voice from listening and speaking and releases the microphone, without unloading the models. Dictation can then be used again.

ui.chat.voice.strip_resume.role: icon button in the composer strip, and its tooltip
ui.chat.voice.strip_resume.note: Recreates the hidden voice page and starts listening again, keeping any mute the person had set.

ui.chat.voice.mute.role: icon button in the composer strip, and its tooltip
ui.chat.voice.mute.note: Silences the assistant’s own spoken replies only - not this app and not any other sound on the machine.

ui.chat.voice.unmute.role: icon button in the composer strip, and its tooltip
ui.chat.voice.unmute.note: Brings the assistant’s spoken replies back after they were silenced.

ui.chat.voice.phase_connecting.note: Shown for a few seconds on a successful start while the hidden page loads and connects; not a failure, so it offers no action.

ui.chat.voice.phase_silenced.note: The reply is playing but the speaker is muted, so nothing is audible.

ui.chat.voice.connecting_caption.note: Says what the connecting chip is waiting on.

ui.chat.voice.silenced_caption.note: Where the words the person cannot hear are; the reply is in the transcript.
